operations.source_name: HM Land Registry INSPIRE July 2026 download catalogue
operations.details_summary: Official catalogue states the current dataset was published 5 July 2026 and new files are published on the first Sunday of every month.

operations.source_name: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons
operations.details_summary: INSPIRE polygons are used as the exact registered-freehold geometry source for this audit, while their indicative-extent limitation is preserved and no legal-boundary claim is inferred.
Official 1 m bare-earth DTM remains the primary parcel-height source; coverage is about 99% of England in EPSG:27700 and the persistent WCS URL is intended to remain stable for future updates.

Environment Agency states the individual LIDAR surveys used by the composite have vertical accuracy of +/-15 cm RMSE; this is retained as a dataset-level error contract, not a parcel confidence interval.

operations.source_name: Environment Agency LIDAR Ground Truth Surveys
operations.details_summary: Independent ground-truth points are stated at +/-3 cm RMSE; LIDAR surveys must report less than +/-15 cm RMSE and 10 cm standard deviation and random error to pass quality control.

operations.source_name: Environment Agency Survey Data Catalogue vertical accuracy
operations.details_summary: EA specifies absolute height error below +/-15 cm RMSE and expected relative height random error no more than +/-5 cm; absolute and relative error remain separate in the parcel QA.

operations.source_name: Environment Agency LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
operations.details_summary: Official time-stamped DTM archive is quarterly, includes survey-specific dates/resolution/transformation/geoid metadata, and its published period extends through 18 April 2024.

operations.source_name: Environment Agency LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
operations.details_summary: A newer archive date does not replace the sampled composite result without an exact survey/tile/geometry byte match; no silent recency substitution is made.
Ordnance Survey states OSGM15 Great Britain height standard error is 0.008 m, excluding GNSS heighting error; transformation error remains separate from terrain-model error.
OS states OSGM15 is about 8 mm RMS for mainland Britain and relative model error within a 10 km extent is at most a few millimetres; this supports datum QA without changing parcel ranges.
OS Terrain 5 is a 5 m post-spacing DTM updated every three months, suitable only as a secondary landscape-scale crosscheck in this workflow.
OS describes typical Terrain 5 accuracy as greater than 2 m RMSE; it is therefore rejected as an accuracy upgrade over the EA 1 m LiDAR primary source.

operations.source_name: HMLR + EA DTM 1m/2m + OSGM15 evidence chain
operations.details_summary: Row 30762 remains 0.270 m at 96% result confidence; source recency revalidation changes no numeric bytes and the existing absolute-95 caution remains.

operations.source_name: HMLR + EA DTM 1m/2m + OSGM15 evidence chain
operations.details_summary: Row 46142 remains 0.831 m at 96% result confidence; both disclosed uncertainty budgets remain passing and the result stays the strongest separated example.

operations.source_name: HMLR + EA DTM 1m/2m + OSGM15 evidence chain
operations.details_summary: Row 61522 remains 0.490 m at 96% result confidence; both budgets remain passing with the previously disclosed narrow absolute margin.
No official source revalidation justified changing any of the three measured height differences; all numeric results and SHA-bound raster evidence are preserved.
Required operator preflight, Git snapshot, existing-runner restart and final canonical export receipts are still absent; no second runner is created.
Current recovery script is not executed because it contains git reset --hard while the controlling continuation contract explicitly forbids reset --hard during recovery.
